title: Parking License Cancellation Notice — the Resident's Signature
content:
A resident cancels a Parking License by signing a cancellation notice, and the end date must be at least the product's notice-to-cancel figure in calendar days after the notice date. The notice carries the early cancellation fee, if one is owed, and that fee is billed with the notice.

## Fixing the fee

The early cancellation fee is fixed only after every idle fee line posted on the license in the three months before the notice date stands at the amount the idle fee schedule sets.

Put the other way round: while any idle fee line posted on the license in those three months does not yet stand at the amount the idle fee schedule sets, the early cancellation fee is not yet fixed.

## The signature tool

**Capability.** `sign_parking_cancellation_notice_d2378b15` is the resident's signature of a cancellation notice that ends one of their parking licenses on a chosen date. The parking license moves to notice-given status with the stated end date as its last licensed day, and when the notice carries an early cancellation fee above zero that fee is billed on the license's parking ledger today and added to the outstanding parking balance; a fee of 0.00 bills nothing. The space stays usable through the end date.

**How it is invoked.** It is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks `sign_parking_cancellation_notice_d2378b15` and hands it over, and the customer themselves signs the notice by running it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `parking_license_id` | the reference number of the parking license being cancelled, as read to the resident by the agent from the parking license lookup | identifier |
| `end_date` | the last licensed day the resident chooses for the space | YYYY-MM-DD, a calendar date in the community's local time |
| `early_cancellation_fee` | the early cancellation fee the notice carries, in USD | 2 decimal places (cents); 0.00 when the notice carries no fee; any further digits are rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A receipt with `parking_license_id` (the license the notice ends), `status` (always `notice_given` for a signed notice), `end_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, the last licensed day), `fee_line_id` (the reference number of the early cancellation fee line, empty when the fee is 0.00), `early_cancellation_fee` (USD with 2 decimal places, the fee billed) and `resulting_parking_balance` (USD with 2 decimal places, the license's outstanding parking balance including any fee the notice bills). A receipt with status `notice_given` means the notice is signed.

## Contract questions

**What does a notice with a fee of 0.00 do to the ledger?** Nothing is billed: `fee_line_id` comes back empty and the balance is unchanged.

**When is the space no longer usable?** After the end date; the space stays usable through the end date itself.
